world_news.headline: Beau Lamarre-Condon trial live updates: former police officer continues evidence in double murder trial
world_news.summary:
Lamarre-Condon returns to witness box for day two of his evidence. He’s accused of shooting couple Jesse Baird and Luke Davies in Sydney in 2024

  • Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast

Lamarre-Condon ‘had an idea’ to dress up as an UberEats rider

Lamarre-Condon tells the court he had seen what he assumed to be someone’s delivery motorcycle:

As soon as I saw that I had an idea … I saw a hi-vis hooded jacket, waterproof long pants and gloves

This moment here … I wish that I didn’t do this.. But I had the thought process that if I was to put on this helmet and outfit I could knock on Jesses’ door I would look like an UberEats driver without any verbal interaction with Jessie.

At the very least I would have had an AVO out against me … police don’t hesitate to put another police on an AVO … I was worried if I knocked on the door it would be perceived as harassment.
